items.heading: Acca Is a Global Professional
items.text: ACCA is a global professional accountancy body. In India, ACCA members work in multinational firms, shared service centres, audit and advisory firms, while some statutory roles in India need Indian qualifications.

items.heading: Read Ten Notices From Firms
items.text: Read ten notices from firms and shared service centres and note whether ACCA is listed, preferred or required. Check the ACCA site for fees and exemptions.

items.heading: Small Businesses Need Bookkeeping, Reporting
items.text: Small businesses need bookkeeping, reporting and finance support.
